extraction.command: ffmpeg -nostdin -hide_banner -loglevel error -n -i <owned MOV> -map 0:a:0 -vn -c:a pcm_s24le <unique owned WAV>

limitations: Waveform correlation cannot prove speech deletion, clip deletion, program visibility, routing, or audibility.
Low-level energy in cut gaps may come from noise, adjacent material, effects, or unobserved protected routing; it is retained as a measured PCM result.
Strong correlation indicates known generated waveform support in program PCM, not its track or bus origin.
The bounded lag is ±1920 samples; the R2-offset baseline result reaches the +1920-sample bound and is interpreted with retained item frame metadata.
No prior rendered baseline PCM was available for R2-offset; the baseline-frame comparison is an alignment prediction against the current output only.
Audio stream start_time was 0.000000 with time_base 1/48000; WAV has no independent PTS field.
overallFinding: The generated program PCM preserves the named full, partial, residual, and shifted supports described above at measured sample windows; the linked and unlinked 60..70 cuts show only low-level residual energy where the second generated support would have occurred. These are artifact-level waveform observations and do not establish editorial deletion, routing, track origin, or final audibility.
